name: affinira
description: Manage professional relationships, digital business cards, contacts and follow-ups with ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Affinira is a professional relationship management platform that helps you keep your business network organised.

Connect Affinira to ChatGPT to update your digital business cards and professional details, search your contacts, see the follow-ups that are due and create and edit your networking events.

Affinira brings your professional identity and the people you meet together in one place, so you can stay organised and keep in touch with the people who matter.

Your cards and profile: see what is on your cards, change your card details (name, headline, company, bio, contact details, links, social profiles and map locations), rename a card's private label, create a new card, and add or change the ventures a card shows.

Card design: change a card's design, colours, text colour, text style, the sections it shows and its languages, and style its QR code. Add or replace the cover photo, photo, logo, icon logo and moving logo, and change how the cover and logo sit (focus, zoom, plate and space). ChatGPT can show you a picture of how the card looks on a phone, tablet or desktop, so you can check each change. To undo a change ChatGPT made, it can restore an earlier version after you confirm (the last 3 versions are kept for 24 hours); a removed or replaced image cannot be brought back.

Contacts and follow-ups: see which follow-ups are due today or overdue, and search your own contacts by name, company, email or phone (up to 10 matches each time).

Networking events: list your events, create new ones and edit their name, dates and place.

You stay in control: you choose what ChatGPT may do on the Affinira consent page. It changes something only if you tick that box, and you can disconnect at any time under Connected apps. It never deletes a card or an event, exports your contacts, sees your team's contacts or sees the links that open your cards. It asks you before it replaces or removes an image, and removes a venture or a venture's logo only after you confirm.
defaultPrompt: Which of my Affinira follow-ups are due?
Show me how my Affinira card looks on a phone.
Give my Affinira card a fresh design and show me the result.

positive.prompt: Show me what is on my Affinira cards.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's two cards with their name, headline, company and contact details, and shows the private label Work on the first card. No link that opens a card is shown.

positive.prompt: Which of my Affinira follow-ups are due?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the two overdue follow-ups with the person, their company and the due date.

positive.prompt: Find Sara in my Affinira contacts.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the contact Sara with her role, email address and phone number.

positive.description: Change a card's headline, then check how it looks
positive.prompt: Change the headline on my Affinira card labelled Work to Head of Sales.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the card labelled Work, changes its headline to Head of Sales, then opens a picture of the card to check the change before saying it is done.

positive.prompt: Create an Affinira event called Test Fair from 1 December 2026 to 2 December 2026 in Madrid.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the event Test Fair with those dates and place and confirms it. Asking to list events afterwards shows it.

negative.description: Deleting a card is not possible
negative.prompt: Delete my Affinira card labelled Work.

negative.description: Exporting all contacts is not possible
negative.prompt: Export all my Affinira contacts to a spreadsheet.

negative.description: The links that open cards are never shared
negative.prompt: Send the link to my Affinira card to my boss by email.

publication.release_notes: First release: manage your Affinira digital business cards and professional profile by asking (details, ventures, design, colours, text style, QR style, cover photo, photo and logos), see how a card looks on a phone, tablet or desktop, check your due follow-ups, search your own contacts, and list, create and edit your networking events.
